parsed.explanation: No traveler-facing criminalisation, targeting, facility ban or border friction is documented, and the operative regime is strongly protective in climate: gender recognition (2009), equality protection for gender reassignment (largely in force 2019), conversion-therapy ban (in force 2024), decriminalisation since 1992 and official apologies. That places it below fully documented 0.85-0.95 systems because traveler-specific protections, prison placement, facilities and violence recourse are not documented and the hate-crime bill status is unresolved, but well above tiers with documented detention, exclusion or police targeting.

entry_documents.interaction: Resident gender-recognition law is a climate signal only; no traveler document-recognition practice is sourced.

investigation_detention_custody.interaction: Sole prison has female, young-offender, vulnerable and segregation units, but no trans-specific placement rule is documented.

federal_state_facilities.interaction: No subnational variation documented; island-wide framework applies, but facilities access for visitors is not sourced.

care_services.interaction: No traveler care, HRT, ward-placement or emergency-care rule is documented; resident healthcare infrastructure is not rated as traveler protection.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: No trans-specific criminal offence documented; consensual same-sex conduct decriminalised in 1992, age of consent equalised by 2006.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Equality Act lists gender reassignment as protected from discrimination; conversion-therapy ban covers gender identity, in force 2024.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Protective statutes are resident-facing climate signals and do not offset any traveler restriction, of which none is documented.

minors_guardians.protection: Parents in a locally recognised same-sex union are not penalised on the documented facts; no minor-specific traveler restriction is sourced.
minors_guardians.interaction: Birth-certificate recognition for same-sex parents after IVF/surrogacy was unresolved in Aug 2023 consultation; this is resident family law, not a visitor exposure.

street_violence_police_response.protection: Police commissioner apologised in 2022 for pre-1992 anti-gay enforcement; head of government apologised for historical convictions.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: No trans-specific violence or killing figures are sourced, so no background-rate comparison can be made and silence is not treated as proven safety.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Hate-crime bill including gender reassignment was in community consultation July 2022; later status not sourced.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Equality Act discrimination prohibition in force from 2019 provides a general remedy framework.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Remedy strength for a short-stay visitor, and whether protections operate in practice, remain undocumented despite functioning legislative institutions.

anchor_checks.comparison: Lower than 0.85-A: that anchor documents visitor document use, police training, oversight and prompt remedies in practice. Here equality and recognition laws are documented, but no traveler-facing operation, complaint outcome or facilities practice is shown.

Higher than 0.75-C: that anchor has documented secondary screening, humiliation and detention risk at borders, albeit with remedies. No such traveler friction, detention or discretionary exclusion is documented here.

Materially higher than 0.65-B: that anchor documents clinic refusal, exposure of notes and billing holds, even though an ombudsperson reversed refusal. No care denial or institutional friction is documented here.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: self-legislating island with early, in-force equality, recognition and conversion-ban laws and no documented hostile traveler rule. Interactions are positive on climate and criminalisation, neutral-to-unknown on border, custody, facilities and care because the dossier is silent. The harshest documented feature is therefore an open question, not a tier-1 universal exposure or tier-2 targeting. Uncertainty caps the score below documented-protection systems, while absence of any known traveler-facing exposure keeps it in Low Risk.
